what: Baseline of every countable surface, so a later read can be DIFFERENCED. Ledger 135.
provenance: MEASURED — every number fetched live at capture time, not carried.
how_to_use: Re-run tools that produced this and DIFF. The eight control items are the point: if the treatment item rises and the controls do not, the rise is attributable to deckwave.fm. If all nine rise together, it is the Archive counter waking up, not usage.
known_fault: The Archive downloads field reads 0 for the treatment item despite the keeper having pressed demo many times, and deckwave fetching every track in FULL. That 0 is VOID, not a measurement (ledger 121/135). This baseline records it anyway, because a 0 that later moves tells us the counter works after a lag; a 0 that never moves tells us it never counted.

archive_org.CORRECTION: The advancedsearch `downloads` field reads 0 for the treatment item and is UNRELIABLE. Use be-api.us.archive.org/views/v1/short|long/<id>, which reports all_time 27 with a real daily series. Both fields are kept here so a later reader can see they disagree.
archive_org.pipeline_staleness: MEASURED 2026-09-06: the views/v1/long daily axis ends 2026-08-16 and the last non-zero day for the treatment item is 2026-08-07. IA's stats pipeline is ~3 weeks behind, so NO Archive data covers the 2026-09-01 launch. A re-read is only meaningful after the axis passes the dates being asked about -- check days[-1] before differencing anything.
archive_org.counting_granularity: Per ITEM and deduplicated, not per file. Publication day scored 7 on an item of 54 files. One demo press is therefore ~1 count, not 9. Expect one per device per day.

counting_links_added.when: 2026-09-06, after the Archive counter was found stale by 3 weeks
counting_links_added.why: Deckwave measures nobody by design - Pages exposes no traffic API, and no analytics script will ever go in this page. The only honest instrument is a link the visitor CHOOSES to follow, counted on a surface that already counts.

links.star: https://github.com/waypostmaster/deckwave (counts a PASSIVE landing - traffic/views plus popular/referrers names deckwave.fm - even from someone with no account who does nothing)

counting_links_added.what_to_diff: github traffic/popular/referrers gaining a deckwave.fm row is the cleanest signal, because it attributes SOURCE. youtube gives totals only; external-source data lives behind Studio login. GitHub traffic is deleted after 14 days, so it must be re-captured fortnightly or it is lost.
